name: Funko, Inc.
summary: Funko, Inc., a pop culture consumer products company, designs, manufactures, and markets licensed pop culture products in the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers media and entertainment content, including movies, television (TV) shows, video games, music, and sports; figures, handbags, backpacks, wallets, apparel, accessories, plush products, homewares, and digital tokens; and art prints and vinyl records, posters, toys, apparel, books, games, and other collectibles.
